sentPolicy.title.notes: COPY-4, COPY-9: 'policy' is jargon. Section sits in Identity tab, not Composer.

sentPolicy.guidance.proposed: Choose where Mailven keeps a copy of each message you send. Some providers save a copy in Sent for you. If both save one, you get two copies, so check your provider's settings first. You can pick more than one folder.

sentPolicy.route.notes: CTRL-5: value shows raw host:port and protocol (SentPolicySection.svelte:38); move to Advanced.

sentPolicy.unreviewed.proposed: You haven't chosen yet. Mailven won't save a copy itself, and warns you when it can't find a copy of a sent message.

sentPolicy.choose.notes: Placeholder; also used as fallback text in copy rows.

sentPolicy.save.notes: COPY-10: 'Save Sent copy policy' is long. Own Save button, not dialog Save.

sentPolicy.evidenceGuidance.proposed: Mailven checks for each sent message in these folders among the mail it has already downloaded, so a copy can show up late. If saving a copy is interrupted, Mailven doesn't try again. A copy in Sent doesn't mean the message arrived.
sentPolicy.evidenceGuidance.notes: COPY-4, COPY-1. Matches sent_policy.go:152 ('No automatic APPEND').

sentPolicy.state.unknown.proposed: Mailven may not have finished saving the copy. Check the folder before you copy the message yourself.
sentPolicy.state.unknown.notes: COPY-8: what happened, then what to do.

sentPolicy.state.appended.proposed: Copy saved. Waiting for it to show up in the folder
